canDoYue: 你識喺電話投訴一張單，要求對方跟進同回覆。
canDoEn: Call about an order, ask them to look into it, and agree a time for an update.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Good morning. I am calling about a recent order, and the reference number is on the gift box.
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨。我打嚟問一張近期嘅單，參考編號喺禮盒上面。
dialogue.say: Good morning. I am calling about a recent order, and the reference number is on the gift box.

dialogue.speaker: ren
dialogue.text: I am sorry for the trouble with it, and I will look into the order with sincere care.
dialogue.glossYue: 唔好意思添咗麻煩，我會認真跟進呢張單。
dialogue.say: I am sorry for the trouble with it, and I will look into the order with sincere care.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The clasp on it broke, so I would like this resolved, and I value a clear update.
dialogue.glossYue: 上面個扣壞咗，我想解決，我重視一個清楚嘅更新。
dialogue.say: The clasp on it broke, so I would like this resolved, and I value a clear update.

dialogue.speaker: ren
dialogue.text: I will escalate the case for you, and I can update you within three business days by phone.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會幫你升級處理，三個工作天之內用電話通知你。
dialogue.say: I will escalate the case for you, and I can update you within three business days by phone.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: If the workshop cannot repair the broken clasp, would compensation or a full replacement be possible?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果工場修唔好個壞扣，可唔可以賠償或者全數換過？
dialogue.say: If the workshop cannot repair the broken clasp, would compensation or a full replacement be possible?

dialogue.speaker: ren
dialogue.text: Your feedback is truly valued by us, and I will resolve this case with a sincere apology.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋真係重視你嘅意見，我會誠懇道歉並解決呢單。
dialogue.say: Your feedback is truly valued by us, and I will resolve this case with a sincere apology.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please look into the reference number for me, and tell me when you can update me by phone.
dialogue.glossYue: 請幫我查個參考編號，再話我知你幾時可以用電話通知我。
dialogue.say: Please look into the reference number for me, and tell me when you can update me by phone.

dialogue.speaker: ren
dialogue.text: I will call you by Friday, and I will resolve the order if the workshop agrees with us.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會星期五之前打電話畀你，如果工場同意，我會解決呢張單。
dialogue.say: I will call you by Friday, and I will resolve the order if the workshop agrees with us.
